scaling.note: Identical to phase 1 - same p, same graph_seed, same trial_seed. Only mean_fear differs.

demo.headline: Same network, fear switched on
demo.caption: Same graph, same two starting banks. The only change: every bank now carries fear (average 0.4), so banks can panic and fail even when their own neighbours are fine. A few do - and the cascade still dies with 8 of 300 gone. In 400 runs at this size, 0 ignited with fear off and 4 with fear on; at the poster's n = 10,000 a bounded seed never ignites, at any fear level.
